remarks: A striking pattern emerged during verification: nearly every Gujarat state-government subdomain directly tied to industrial/factory licensing (dish.gujarat.gov.in, ifp.gujarat.gov.in, ic.gujarat.gov.in, udhyog.gujarat.gov.in, labour.gujarat.gov.in, egazette.gujarat.gov.in) timed out or reset the connection on repeated attempts this session, while other Gujarat state subdomains on apparently the same gujarat.gov.in infrastructure (gidc.gujarat.gov.in, directorit.gujarat.gov.in, sje.gujarat.gov.in) responded normally. This looks like genuine server-side unavailability/blocking of those specific hosts rather than a client-side or proxy policy issue (the agent proxy's own status log shows plain timeouts/resets for these, not policy-denial codes), but it means the single most relevant source for FAL in Gujarat — the DISH Gujarat portal itself — could not be verified this session despite being named consistently by multiple secondary sources as the actual application channel.

Multiple secondary/consultancy sources (agileregulatory.com, corpzo.com, professionalutilities.com, etc.) consistently describe the Gujarat Factory License process as: issuing authority = Directorate of Industrial Safety & Health (DISH), Gujarat; application channel = DISH portal and/or the IFP single-window portal; legal basis = Factories Act, 1948 as applied/amended in Gujarat (most recently via the Factories (Gujarat Amendment) Act, 2025 and the Gujarat Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Rules, 2025, which reportedly replaced the Gujarat Factories Rules, 1963). None of these specific claims could be independently confirmed against a live official Gujarat government page this session, since every directly relevant Gujarat domain was unreachable and the only working copies of the 2025 rules/ordinance text found via search were hosted on private law-firm/compliance sites (lawrbit.com, lkslaw.com, simpliance.in), which do not qualify as government sources under this spec and were therefore not fetched/listed at all.

The one directly useful, independently verified fact about the Gujarat-specific authority came indirectly, via the central DGFASLI/DGOSH 'Important Addresses' PDF, which names the Director, Industrial Safety & Health, Gujarat and an official dish-ahd@gujarat.gov.in contact — corroborating, from an independently-reachable central government source, that DISH Gujarat is indeed the relevant authority, even though its own portal could not be reached directly.

No independently verifiable official Gujarat government page or document could be confirmed this session for: the current Gujarat Factories Rules/OSH Rules 2025 full text, a Factory-License-specific document checklist, or the fee schedule — all were excluded per the spec's 'when in doubt, exclude' rule rather than included on the strength of search snippets or third-party legal-site copies.
